name: Being A Stepmom
overview: Being a stepmom involves embracing God's design for family as rooted in His creation of male and female in His image, reflecting the dignity and value of every person. Trusting in the Lord wholeheartedly is essential in navigating the unique challenges of blended families, relying on His wisdom rather than personal understanding. The Proverbs passage encourages honoring the diligent work and faithfulness of women, which applies to stepmoms who labor faithfully in their role, seeking to glorify God through their care and commitment.
